recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key portrait of a Black man emerging from absolute blackness. The lighting is focused solely on the face and a hand holding a small object, creating a dramatic chiaroscuro effect where the body and clothing are completely invisible, merged into the dark background.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical alignment between the illuminated face and the illuminated hand
Extreme contrast between deep shadows and warm skin highlights
Text positioned in the upper-left quadrant to balance the central vertical axis
coreInvariants: Selective lighting on facial features and hand only
Absence of visible clothing or torso

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Face centered in the upper half; hand centered in the lower half; large scale relative to the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the illuminated object in the hand.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the face, moves down the vertical axis to the hand, then shifts to the top-left typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant; approximately 85% of the frame is solid black negative space.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in specific focal points.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family using weight and case contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 70s geometric soul aesthetic and tight tracking.
Provides the necessary geometric weight and clean terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A portrait of a Black man with a beard in a dark room, lit with a single overhead spotlight so only his face and his hand holding a cookie are visible. The rest of his body and the background are pure black. High contrast, cinematic film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of heavy geometric sans-serif text in the top left corner. The top line should be all caps, the bottom line all lowercase. Use white color and tight line spacing.

verificationChecks: Are the torso and shoulders invisible?
Is the text left-aligned in the upper-left quadrant?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no 'ghosting' of the body is visible in the shadows.
Check that the hand and face are vertically aligned.
Verify typography is sharp and legible against the black.
Confirm the lighting feels directional and intentional.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Low-Key Chiaroscuro Portrait] + [Pure Black Negative Space] + [Top-Left Geometric Sans-Serif Typography] to create a soul-inspired minimalist cover.
